equation2_poisson_count_pmf_formula.tex_statement: \forall (rate exposure : ℝ) (count : ℕ), sourcePoissonPMF rate exposure count = exp (-(rate * exposure)) * (rate * exposure) ^ count / ↑factorial

equation33_nyc_preprocessing_stopping_ob.tex_statement: \forall {\Omega : Type u_1} {m\Omega : MeasurableSpace \Omega} (𝓕 : Filtration ℝ m\Omega) (startTime inspectionTime workOrderTime : \Omega \to ℝ), IsStoppingTime 𝓕 startTime \to IsStoppingTime 𝓕 inspectionTime \to IsStoppingTime 𝓕 workOrderTime \to (\forall (\omega : \Omega), startTime \omega \le inspectionTime \omega) \to (\forall (\omega : \Omega), startTime \omega \le workOrderTime \omega) \to \exists W, startTime = startTime \land (endTime = fun \omega  =>  min (min (startTime \omega + 100) (inspectionTime \omega)) (workOrderTime \omega)) \land \forall (\omega : \Omega), 0 \le exposure \omega

equation34_chicago_preprocessing_stoppin.tex_statement: \forall {\Omega : Type u_1} {m\Omega : MeasurableSpace \Omega} (𝓕 : Filtration ℝ m\Omega) (firstReportTime closedTime retrievalTime : \Omega \to ℝ), IsStoppingTime 𝓕 firstReportTime \to IsStoppingTime 𝓕 closedTime \to IsStoppingTime 𝓕 retrievalTime \to (\forall (\omega : \Omega), firstReportTime \omega \le closedTime \omega) \to (\forall (\omega : \Omega), firstReportTime \omega \le retrievalTime \omega) \to \exists W, startTime = firstReportTime \land (endTime = fun \omega  =>  min (min (firstReportTime \omega + 100) (closedTime \omega)) (retrievalTime \omega)) \land \forall (\omega : \Omega), 0 \le exposure \omega

equation3_mle_global_logLikelihood_max.tex_statement: \forall {totalCount : ℕ} {totalExposure rate : ℝ}, totalCount \ne 0 \to 0 < totalExposure \to 0 < rate \to poissonRateLogLikelihood totalCount totalExposure rate \le poissonRateLogLikelihood totalCount totalExposure (mleRate totalCount totalExposure)

equation3_mle_score_equation.tex_statement: \forall {totalCount : ℕ} {totalExposure : ℝ}, totalCount \ne 0 \to totalExposure \ne 0 \to poissonRateScore totalCount totalExposure (mleRate totalCount totalExposure) = 0

equation5_poisson_regression_rate_formul.tex_statement: \forall {Feature : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Feature] (alpha : ℝ) (beta theta : Feature \to ℝ), poissonRegressionRate alpha beta theta = exp (alpha + \sum j, beta j * theta j)

equation6_poisson_regression_likelihood_.tex_statement: \forall {Feature : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Feature] (alpha : ℝ) (beta theta : Feature \to ℝ) (exposure : ℝ) (count : ℕ), poissonRegressionIncidentLikelihood alpha beta theta exposure count = sourcePoissonPMF (exp (alpha + \sum j, beta j * theta j)) exposure count

equation7_zero_inflated_likelihood_posit.tex_statement: \forall {gamma rate exposure : ℝ} {count : ℕ}, count \ne 0 \to zeroInflatedIncidentLikelihood gamma rate exposure count = (1 - gamma) * sourcePoissonPMF rate exposure count

equation7_zero_inflated_likelihood_zero.tex_statement: \forall (gamma rate exposure : ℝ), zeroInflatedIncidentLikelihood gamma rate exposure 0 = gamma + (1 - gamma) * sourcePoissonPMF rate exposure 0

first_report_probability_formula.tex_statement: \forall (reportingRate duration : ℝ), firstReportProbability reportingRate duration = 1 - exp (-(reportingRate * duration))

lemma1_continuous_duration_first_report_.tex_statement: \forall (reportingRate : ℝ) (durationDensity : ℝ \to ℝ), \int (t : ℝ) in Ici 0, durationDensity t = 1 \to Integrable durationDensity (restrict (Ici 0)) \to Integrable (fun t  =>  durationDensity t * noArrivalProb reportingRate t) (restrict (Ici 0)) \to continuousDurationFirstReportProbability reportingRate durationDensity = \int (t : ℝ) in Ici 0, durationDensity t * firstReportProbability reportingRate t

lemma1_continuous_duration_observed_rate.tex_statement: \forall (incidentRate reportingRate : ℝ) (durationDensity : ℝ \to ℝ), \int (t : ℝ) in Ici 0, durationDensity t = 1 \to Integrable durationDensity (restrict (Ici 0)) \to Integrable (fun t  =>  durationDensity t * noArrivalProb reportingRate t) (restrict (Ici 0)) \to continuousDurationObservedIncidentRate incidentRate reportingRate durationDensity = incidentRate * \int (t : ℝ) in Ici 0, durationDensity t * firstReportProbability reportingRate t

lemma1_continuous_duration_poisson_thinn.tex_statement: \forall (incidentMean reportingRate : ℝ) (durationDensity : ℝ \to ℝ) (observedCount : ℕ), \sum' (originalCount : ℕ), countLikelihood 1 incidentMean originalCount * binomialThinningMass (continuousDurationFirstReportProbability reportingRate durationDensity) originalCount observedCount = countLikelihood 1 (continuousDurationObservedIncidentRate incidentMean reportingRate durationDensity) observedCount

lemma1_finite_duration_first_report_weig.tex_statement: \forall {DurationType : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype DurationType] (reportingRate : ℝ) (weight duration : DurationType \to ℝ), \sum d, weight d = 1 \to finiteDurationFirstReportProbability reportingRate weight duration = \sum d, weight d * firstReportProbability reportingRate (duration d)

lemma2_exponential_waiting_tail.tex_statement: \forall (rate : ℝ) (h_rate : 0 < rate) {epsilon lower : ℝ}, 0 \le epsilon \to \forall {elapsed startDensity : ℝ \to ℝ}, \int (s : ℝ) in Ici lower, startDensity s = 1 \to (\forall (s : ℝ), 0 \le rate * elapsed s) \to \int (s : ℝ) in Ici lower, (noArrivalProb rate epsilon * \sum' (count : ℕ), countLikelihood rate (elapsed s) count) * startDensity s = ({ rate := rate, rate_pos := h_rate }.measure (Ioi epsilon)).toReal

lemma2_exponential_waiting_tail_memoryle.tex_statement: \forall (rate : ℝ) (h_rate : 0 < rate) {elapsed future : ℝ}, 0 \le elapsed \to 0 \le future \to ({ rate := rate, rate_pos := h_rate }.measure (Ioi (elapsed + future))).toReal / ({ rate := rate, rate_pos := h_rate }.measure (Ioi elapsed)).toReal = ({ rate := rate, rate_pos := h_rate }.measure (Ioi future)).toReal

proposition1_continuous_duration_noniden.tex_statement:
orall (durationDensity : ℝ 	o ℝ) {observedRate rate₁ rate₂ : ℝ}, rate₁ 
e rate₂ 	o continuousDurationFirstReportProbability rate₁ durationDensity 
e 0 	o continuousDurationFirstReportProbability rate₂ durationDensity 
e 0 	o rate₁

proposition1_homogeneous_nonidentifiabil.tex_statement:
orall {observedRate rate₁ rate₂ duration : ℝ}, rate₁

e 0 	o firstReportProbability rate₂ duration

e rate₂ \land homogeneousObservedIncidentRate (observedRate / firstReportProbability rate₁ duration) rate₁ duration = homogeneousObservedIncidentRate (observedRate / firstReportProbability rate₂ duration) rate₂ duration

theorem1_likelihood_decomposition_from_p.tex_statement: \forall {\Omega : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace \Omega] {P : Measure \Omega} (H : HomogeneousPoissonCountingProcessByLaw \Omega P) (K : Theorem2ConditionFunctions) (C : Theorem2ObservedWindowCase), likelihoodFromPoissonIncrementLaws K H C = residualWith K C * sourcePoissonPMF rate (exposureWith K C) (countWith K C)

theorem1_likelihood_product_decompositio.tex_statement: \forall {\Omega : Type u_1} {Incident : Type u_2} [inst : MeasurableSpace \Omega] {P : Measure \Omega} (H : HomogeneousPoissonCountingProcessByLaw \Omega P) (K : Theorem2ConditionFunctions) (s : Finset Incident) (C : Incident \to Theorem2ObservedWindowCase), (totalExposure s fun i  =>  exposureWith K (C i)) \ne 0 \to \prod i \in s, likelihoodFromPoissonIncrementLaws K H (C i) = productResidualWith K s C * sourcePoissonPMF rate (totalExposure s fun i  =>  exposureWith K (C i)) (totalCount s fun i  =>  countWith K (C i))

theorem2_corrected_case_factorization.tex_statement: \forall {kernelResidual rate exposure : ℝ} {count : ℕ}, exposure \ne 0 \to theorem2RawCaseLikelihood kernelResidual rate exposure count = theorem2CorrectedResidual kernelResidual exposure count * sourcePoissonPMF rate exposure count

theorem2_multi_report_source_case.tex_statement: \forall {startDensity endDensityAfterLastJump survivalIntegralProduct rate exposure : ℝ} {count : ℕ}, 1 < count \to exposure \ne 0 \to 1 < count \land theorem2MultiReportLikelihood startDensity endDensityAfterLastJump survivalIntegralProduct rate exposure count = theorem2CorrectedResidual (theorem2MultiReportKernelResidual startDensity endDensityAfterLastJump survivalIntegralProduct) exposure count * sourcePoissonPMF rate exposure count

theorem2_one_report_source_case.tex_statement: \forall {startDensity endDensityAfterJump endSurvivalIntegral rate exposure : ℝ}, exposure \ne 0 \to theorem2OneReportLikelihood startDensity endDensityAfterJump endSurvivalIntegral rate exposure = theorem2OneReportKernelResidual startDensity endDensityAfterJump endSurvivalIntegral / exposure * sourcePoissonPMF rate exposure 1

theorem2_zero_report_source_case.tex_statement: \forall (startDensity endDensity rate exposure : ℝ), theorem2ZeroReportLikelihood startDensity endDensity rate exposure = theorem2ZeroReportResidual startDensity endDensity * sourcePoissonPMF rate exposure 0
